pr_title: [WIP] Restclient allow to set group version per request and use only one transport for all generated clients
pr_body:
/kind feature
/kind bug

Building on top of https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/97821 , allow to set the groupVersion per request and to create a RESTClient without the groupVersion set.

It defaults to the configured one, if set, for backwards compatibility.

There are multiple issues related
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/100849
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/103224

The end goal is to have a single transport for everything ...

```
	// create the RESTClient
	r, err := rest.RESTClientFor(config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err.Error())
	}
        // create the clientset
	clientset := kubernetes.New(r)
```

```release-note
RESTClient allows to set the group and version
```

issue_context.title: `kubernetes.New(c rest.Interface) *Clientset` api is not usable
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please use this template while reporting a bug and provide as much info as possible. Not doing so may result in your bug not being addressed in a timely manner. Thanks!

If the matter is security related, please disclose it privately via https://kubernetes.io/security/
-->


#### What happened:
https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/v0.21.2/kubernetes/clientset.go#L637

I am trying to use the `kubernetes.New(c rest.Interface) *Clientset` api to create a client. But it turns out that this facade api is not usable. The key issue is that I can only set one `APIPath` to the `rest.Interface` and it fails for any other api group versions with an error `the server could not find the requested resource`.

#### What you expected to happen:

#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):

#### Anything else we need to know?:

The issue seems to be that `rest.Interface` is a "getter" type interface. To fix this, the generated code should be able to set the correct group_version (hence api path) in their respective `.New(rest.Interface)` api. So, a method like

`ForGroupVersion(gv schema.GroupVersion) rest.Interface` could be added to rest.Interface and then update the generated code to use this method to properly set the GroupVersion in their respective `.New(rest.Interface)` methods.

#### Environment:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): any version of k8s.io.client-go
- Cloud provider or hardware configuration:
- OS (e.g: `cat /etc/os-release`):
- Kernel (e.g. `uname -a`):
- Install tools:
- Network plugin and version (if this is a network-related bug):
- Others:


/kind bug
comments:
it is working as intended, it is not a bug. 

GroupVersion must be set when initializing RESTClient
 https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/843bb800b12ac5b3f0d273bd39f889e248b43fed/rest/config.go#L290

> it is working as intended, it is not a bug.
> 
> GroupVersion must be set when initializing RESTClient
> https://github.com/kubernetes/client-go/blob/843bb800b12ac5b3f0d273bd39f889e248b43fed/rest/config.go#L290

But that means a RESTClient can only be used for a single group/version, and kubernetes.New(rest.Interface) uses the provided RESTClient for lots of group/versions, which doesn't work.

I experimented with fixing this in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/97821 but didn't make a lot of progress
